method: Bounded native constructors, stack allocation, profile reader and writer; file endpoints controlled. Full object bytes, written bytes, I/O calls, AL result, stack and saved registers compared.
safety_differences: Unread stack bytes in old/partial profiles are initialized to zero in C; the comparator initializes the native stack to zero.
C rejects nonterminated active names and out-of-range destination name counts; these malformed-input checks are separate C tests.
limitations: This checks persistence contracts, not the complete family-menu controller or operating-system file implementation.
